review.rationale: The Decision's recommendation chain is internally consistent (Recommendation, review, commit, and remote verification all referenced and aligned). Both prior failure archives are explicitly preserved with overwrite_authorized=false and prior_failure_preservation=true. The bsdtar contract specifies the required --no-mac-metadata and --no-xattrs flags, and the raw-member contract exactly matches the 87/21/66/65/1/0 shape with zero appledouble/duplicate/special members. Execution is strictly one-attempt fail-closed (retries=0, no fallbacks, explicit stop conditions, single worktree/archive/fetch). No deployment, release, or authority inference is created (deployment/release/authority_created all false, status explicitly includes NO_DEPLOYMENT_AUTHORIZED).
